name: Where Did I Park - Car Finder

ios.desc:
Never lose your car again.
Save your parked car, set parking timers, and track reminders with Where Did I Park – Car Finder.
One tap to save your spot, one tap to find it — fast, private, and built for simplicity.
No ads. No tracking. Just peace of mind every time you park.


Where Did I Park is your personal parking tracker that helps you remember exactly where you parked, avoid parking fines, and manage multiple cars with ease.
With just one tap, you can mark your car’s location and get guided back whenever you need. Add notes, set a parking reminder, and even keep track of your entire parking history — all in one clean, modern app.

== Key Features ==
- One-Tap Parking: Instantly save your car’s location and navigate back anytime.
- Find My Car: Quickly locate your parked car using your favorite map app.
- Parking Timer & Reminder: Avoid parking tickets with smart alerts before your meter expires.
- Multiple Cars: Track all your vehicles in one place — name, color, and icon included.
- Notes & History: Keep a detailed record of where and when you parked.
- Customization: Change the color, icons, and overall look to fit your style.
- Private by Design: Your data stays in your iCloud — only you can access it. No ads. No tracking.

Built entirely by one person — no investors, no big company. Just a simple, fast, and privacy-first app that makes parking stress-free.

More features are on the way to make Where Did I Park even more helpful like Widget, Live Activities, Photos.

Privacy Policy: https://wdip.site/privacy
Terms & Conditions: https://wdip.site/terms

== Proudly built in Hanoi, Vietnam. ==

quotes.text:
No sign-ups, no clutter, no background tracking — just a minimal parking reminder that feels instant.

Key features:
 One-tap “Save Spot”
 Parking timer and reminders
 Private by default (no analytics, no tracking etc)

I made it because I got tired of opening Maps every time I parked and waiting for it to figure things out. Now I just tap once, lock my phone, and go.

Would love feedback — especially on the new feature you would like see (if you have the need for such utility app)

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/where-did-i-park-find-my-car/id6751573328
